purpose: Audit temperature support and NH4 prediction errors before changing the surrogate
scope: Exploratory diagnosis, not causal attribution or a model selection test
temperature_groups: Input temperature at transition t: below train minimum, inside train min/max, above train maximum
interventions: Hold all other observed input features fixed, replace temperature only; diagnostic model response, not real process intervention
decision: Determine whether low-temperature extrapolation alone is a sufficient explanation. Do not tune thresholds or change environment based on a scalar error reduction alone.
